endpoint.description: NSFOCUS WAF REST API base URL, for example https://waf.example.com:8443.

apiVersion.description: REST API version path segment. The current implementation is calibrated against the V6.0.7.3 REST document and uses v3 endpoints by default.

accountId.description: NSFOCUS WAF API account id used to fetch V3 OAuth token.

headers.description: Optional extra HTTP headers sent to NSFOCUS WAF.

skipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for private deployments.
